scope: Public asset candidates for Beckenburg's shared reference library, Red Ledger / Between Deliveries, ReverieVR native games, and Gumball Armada
inventory_caveat: Comparison against named Drive root sources plus current Beckenburg equipment/asset docs only. Inner contents of newly supplied archives, paid PSX mega pack and independent ReverieVR holdings have not been exhaustively hash-checked. 'Gap' means missing or unverified capability; do not assert zero existing equivalent meshes.
prohibited_shortcuts: Never replace approved hunter/ghost concept art with unrelated thumbnails/meshes.
Never relabel not-downloaded files as archived, staged or integrated.
External packs do not inherit purchased PSX Mega Pack license.
No wholesale insertion into Java or Galaxy S9 release builds; curate, provenance-track, convert and test selected source files.
No GitHub Actions for this catalogue.

priority_definitions.P1: clear novel capability or immediately relevant missing module
priority_definitions.P2: likely useful after confirmed location/module scope
priority_definitions.P3: overlap or purchase risk; defer pending inventory
